title: A table for four seasons
alt: Sculptural paper food, foliage and porcelain surround an eleven-part Chinese exhibition programme.
description: Sculptural paper food, foliage and porcelain surround an eleven-part Chinese exhibition programme.
prompt:
A richly designed Chinese food-culture exhibition programme. Beautiful sculptural paper still lifes of a citrus branch, tea leaves, a ripe strawberry tart, steaming soup and intricate blue-and-white porcelain dishes frame an airy ivory central tablecloth. Elaborate paper layers, finely cut edges and realistic soft shadows; fresh green, strawberry red, lemon yellow and cream. The illustrations curve naturally around the central readable programme. A large title and three clearly separated paragraphs use crisp Chinese lettering in the clean central space. The surrounding illustration and typography form one integrated finished design.
The complete text on the page reads: “把四季端上餐桌” “一日三餐，也有值得收藏的风景” “一场关于食物与生活的展览” “寻找新鲜” “沿着季节的脚步，发现今天的味道。” “认真烹调” “把简单的食材，变成温暖的一餐。” “慢慢分享” “留一点时间，和喜欢的人坐在一起。” “食物文化与设计展” “周末十点至十八点”. Render only this quoted copy, with natural line breaks and clear, correct lettering. No extra words.
